common.loading: One moment, we're rolling out the mat…

footer.mission: The digital and legal gateway for African entrepreneurs. Create, formalise, grow, with people by your side.
footer.disclaimer: KEC provides general information and support; no individual legal advice is given online.

hero.lead: KEC (K-Enterprise Counsel) helps you create, formalise and grow your company in Africa, with a legal firm, transparent pricing, and your documents kept safe.
hero.waiting: {n} entrepreneurs are already waiting, coffee in hand

globe.title: And Africa is at the centre.
globe.text: Wherever you are: New York, Berlin, Paris, Montréal, Moscow, Amsterdam, Rome… your project finds its way home. KEC connects the diaspora and local entrepreneurs around one ambition: building here, to last.

card.hint: Hover or tap a country: it turns red and introduces itself.
card.default: KEC supports you here: incorporation, formalisation, legal follow-up.
card.toValidate: Fact to be validated by KEC

services.title: From a dream scribbled in a notebook to the official stamp.
services.lead: A platform designed for small and medium-sized businesses, backed by a real team.

create.title: Create your file
create.text: Pick your country, city and legal form. We guide you step by step, with the full quote shown upfront.

formalize.title: Formalise your structure
formalize.text: Articles, RCCM, documents: you fill in one dedicated form, we draft and track the file.

grow.title: Grow your business
grow.text: Training, post-incorporation follow-up and a place in the KEC business network.

vault.title: Legal vault
vault.text: All your documents, encrypted, in one place. KEC-certified company account.

manu.title: Manu AI
manu.text: A receptionist who welcomes you day and night, guides you, and hands over to a legal professional when needed.

consultant.title: A consultant, whenever you want
consultant.text: Need advice? Book a KEC consultant and pay with MoMo, Orange Money or bank transfer.

program.title: 110 seats. Not one more.
program.text: Before the large-scale launch, we support a first cohort of 110 entrepreneurs for 6 months. Anyone can sign up; KEC picks the 110 fellows from the waiting list.

points.selection: Selection based on applications from the waiting room
points.duration: 6 months of incubation and human support
points.certification: Certified, visible company account at the end of the programme

nostalgia.title: Home has not forgotten you.
nostalgia.text: The smell of the earth after the first rain. Morning coffee at grandma's. Voices under the palaver tree. Been away for a long time? Your company can be born here, and bring you a little closer to home.
nostalgia.cta: Come back through the front door

guides.title: Create, advise, invest: the continent, one page at a time.
guides.lead: One question, one page. KEC Consulting covers company creation in Africa, a legal office, investing, and doing business on the continent.

cards.create: OHADA filings, SARL, RCCM: how to create a company in Africa, from the country or the diaspora.
cards.legal: A legal firm in Africa that answers: consultants, video, Douala, Yaoundé, Bafoussam.
cards.invest: Invest in Africa without the blur: local vehicle, partners, Kia channel.
cards.business: Do business in Africa with a clean structure, a network and a vault.
cards.brand: KEC, KEC Africa, KEC Consulting: the same firm, kec-africa.com.

waiting.title: Akwaba! Have a seat, we'll serve you something.
waiting.manuHello: Here in Africa, we never welcome people empty-handed. What can we get you to drink? Tea? Coffee? White wine?
waiting.manuServed: Take your time with the form; nobody's in a hurry here.
waiting.coffeeAria: Enamel kettle, clay cup and welcome offerings
waiting.formLead: Three short steps, under three minutes. Then you get your ticket.
proverbs: One hand alone cannot tie the koki.
If you want to go fast, go alone; if you want to go far, go together.
Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
Patience is a tree with bitter roots but very sweet fruit.
A single bracelet does not jingle.
The new rope is woven at the end of the old one.

legalFormsInfo.sas: Great freedom in the articles, popular with investors.

legalFormsInfo.gie: A grouping to pool resources between companies.

fellow.quote: One hundred and ten cowries, one hundred and ten business stories.
